caption: The drawing depicts a ceiling-mounted chandelier suspended by three thin gold chains that converge at a central ring above the fixture. The main circular structure of the chandelier is composed of a wide, shallow bowl-like form that is predominantly a soft, beige color with subtle pink and cream marbling, bordered by a narrow dark green band at the top edge. From the sides of this circular structure extend six upward-curving, narrow gold arms, each ending in an empty candle holder, and from the end of each arm hangs a single teardrop-shaped, translucent crystal ornament. The bottom center of the chandelier features a conical dark green and marbled beige element, from which a decorative tassel hangs downward, colored in shades of gold and blue. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. There is a small, neat signature in the lower right area of the image.
title: Chandelier
